## Problem

What user, operational, or architectural problem should be solved?

## Proposed outcome

Describe the observable result. A complete implementation design is not required.

## Constraints and trade-offs

Which guarantees, module boundaries, compatibility concerns, or failure modes matter?

## Alternatives considered

What simpler or different approaches were considered?

## Documentation impact

Which canonical document or invariant would need to change if this proposal is accepted?
